content.title: Nomura (TSE:9716) Margin Soars to 6%, Challenging Bearish Earnings Narratives
content.summary: NOMURA (TSE:9716) posted a standout year, with net profit margins jumping to 6% from 2.3% and earnings growth over the past twelve months hitting a remarkable 241.4%. This is well ahead of its 5-year average of 18.4% per year. Despite forecasts signaling a 1.3% annual revenue decline and a 3.7% drop in earnings over the next three years, recent results reveal the company’s ability to drive robust profit expansion and margin improvement even amid challenging conditions. content.title: Weak Labor Market Fuel for Rally: Nomura's Nicholson
content.description: Nomura's CIO and Head of Discretionary Portfolio Management Gareth Nicholson tells Bloomberg TV that a relatively weak labor market could fuel an equities rally due to its impact on the Fed's likelihood to cut rates, while a government shutdown could increase risk for investors if it delays the release of a much-anticipated jobs report.
